decisions.statement: Every route here is drawn in the browser rather than on a server.
The view a route here draws comes from the folder beside this router app.
No route here answers an api address.
A module reaching a node builtin fails the client build rather than the phone.
The server entry here runs once at build time rather than on a request.
What parts this build from alan/web's is the folder each build runs in and that folder's config.

definition: the routes Alan's site serves inside the shell on his phone
